text:
pagerbot: PAGER: High packet/drop anomaly detected for inference fleet in az1a. p95 latency ↑, error-rate spike. Runbook suggested: az-nic-deg. Paging @maria_oncall and SRE oncall.

maria_oncall: ack — jumping in. Initial graphs show ENI rx-errors and retransmits from a subset of ephemeral hosts (g5-03*, g5-07*). Kept seeing soft NIC resets in kernel logs. Dumping ring stats now.

maria_oncall: ```
[  0.000] rx_errors: 1245, tx_errors: 3
[  0.001] ifconfig eth0: rx_crc_errors=112, rx_missed_errors=8
[  0.002] dmesg | tail: net: eth0 NIC reset detected (vf 2)
```

kevin_sre: copy. If it's rx errors at the host NIC layer, we should avoid cold starts in az1a and drain ephemerals. I'll prepare traffic-steer to eu1a and usw2a. Recommend partial evacuation 30-50% as canary.

ashley_net: net-team see route instability out of the AZ's NAT gateway around the times noted. Opening AWS case now — possible hypervisor NIC driver flapping. I have tracebacks to share with AWS.

maria_oncall: initiating canary drain: `/runbook evict-ephemeral --az az1a --percent 40 --tag incident/3322223333` Starting canary shift to eu1a.

ops-bot: evac job queued: evac-3322223333 started (40% drain). Estimated completion 4m. Progress: 0/40 hosts drained. Link: https://internal.ops/evac/3322223333

jordan_cs: noting customer impact — some inference requests are returning 502s and elevated tail latency for requests pinned to az1a. Drafting status update for post. Will include mitigation and ETA.

infra_pm: pause any heavy model-loading jobs and new infra launches in az1a until we confirm stability. We should avoid autoscale bringing new hosts into the degraded pool.

kevin_sre: canary completed: shifted ~60% traffic off az1a (manual steer). p95 on redirected traffic back to baseline. Remaining hosts in az1a still show retransmit bursts but overall customer impact reduced. Continuing drain.

ashley_net: AWS case created #1234567890. AWS has correlated our instance IDs with host-level NIC soft resets and is scheduling hypervisor remediation in ~20m. They'll advise whether live migration/instance move is needed.

maria_oncall: plan for next 30m: finish draining remaining ephemerals, set routing policy to avoid az1a for inference traffic, pause autoscale, and notify top impacted customers. If AWS requests, we'll perform instance move for any non-evictable hosts.

jordan_cs: sending targeted notices to top 10 customers now with templated text: "We've observed transient inference errors and elevated latency affecting a subset of requests in Region X; mitigation in progress — traffic is being rerouted. We'll update within 30m." :email: :thumbsup:

kevin_sre: traffic shift ~95% complete. Remaining p95 deviations are noise-level. Will keep observing for 15m stabilization window. If stable, we can lift the page.

maria_oncall: handing off next update to night oncall — add these handoff notes: what we executed (evac commands, routing avoid policy), AWS case #1234567890, paused autoscale, incident doc link. @ops-bot please create incident ticket and attach logs.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-3322223333. Attachments: evac logs, dmesg snippets, AWS case link. Next action: monitoring 15m stabilization.

maria_oncall: final — I'll open the postmortem once AWS confirms hypervisor remediation outcome. Thanks all, will update if AWS asks for further host moves. :white_check_mark:
